name: Government Education Support Scheme
description: A test government scheme providing financial support to eligible students for education-related expenses.
ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
benefits: Financial assistance to eligible students for education-related expenses.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Residence Certificate, Bank Account Details, Academic Certificate
application_process: Eligible students can apply through the designated government education portal by completing the application form and submitting the required documents.

name: PM-USP - Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
description: A merit-based scholarship scheme for students pursuing higher education in colleges and universities.
ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of Higher Education
benefits: Financial assistance through scholarships to eligible meritorious students pursuing college and university education.
documents_required: Academic certificates, income certificate, bank account details, Aadhaar or other required identification documents.
application_process: Students register through the National Scholarship Portal, complete the scholarship application and submit it for verification.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
description: A scholarship scheme intended to encourage meritorious students from economically weaker sections to continue their education.
ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
benefits: Scholarship assistance for eligible students to support continuation of education.
documents_required: Academic records, income certificate, category certificate where applicable, bank account details and identification documents.
application_process: Eligible students apply through the National Scholarship Portal and applications are verified by the prescribed authorities.

name: PM YASASVI Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education
description: A central sector scholarship scheme supporting higher education of eligible OBC, EBC and DNT students.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Financial assistance for eligible students pursuing higher education in institutions covered under the scheme.
documents_required: Academic certificates, income certificate, category certificate, bank account details and Aadhaar.
application_process: Eligible students apply through the National Scholarship Portal followed by institutional and government verification.

name: Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman (PM POSHAN)
description: A centrally sponsored scheme providing nutritious cooked meals to eligible children studying in Balvatika and Classes I to VIII in Government and Government-aided schools.
ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
benefits: Provision of nutritious cooked meals on school days to eligible children.
documents_required: School enrollment records, student records and implementation documents as prescribed by authorities.
application_process: The scheme is implemented through States and Union Territories in partnership with the Ministry of Education.

name: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students
description: A central sector scholarship scheme supporting eligible Scheduled Caste students pursuing higher education.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Financial assistance to eligible SC students pursuing higher education.
documents_required: Academic certificates, caste certificate, income certificate, bank account details and Aadhaar.
application_process: Eligible students apply through the National Scholarship Portal and applications undergo institutional and government verification.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: A Central Sector scheme providing income support to eligible landholding farmer families across India.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year transferred directly to eligible farmer families in three equal installments.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, land ownership records, bank account details and other documents required for beneficiary verification.
application_process: Eligible farmers can register through the PM-KISAN portal and complete the required verification and eKYC process.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: A national health protection scheme providing cashless hospitalization coverage to eligible poor and vulnerable families.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
department: National Health Authority
benefits: Cashless hospitalization coverage of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare.
documents_required: Aadhaar or other accepted identification documents and beneficiary verification documents.
application_process: Eligible beneficiaries can check their eligibility and access benefits through empanelled hospitals and designated government channels.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0
description: A housing mission aimed at providing affordable pucca houses to eligible urban households.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
department: Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Housing assistance for eligible urban households through the applicable PMAY-U 2.0 verticals.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, identity proof, income-related documents, address proof and other documents required for eligibility verification.
application_process: Applicants can register online through the PMAY-U 2.0 portal and complete the eligibility and Aadhaar authentication process.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
description: A rural housing scheme aimed at providing pucca houses with basic amenities to eligible rural households.
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
department: Department of Rural Development
benefits: Financial assistance for construction of pucca houses for eligible rural households.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, bank account details, rural household records and documents required by the implementing authority.
application_process: Eligible beneficiaries are identified through the prescribed rural housing and government verification process.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
description: A rural employment programme providing a legal guarantee of wage employment to rural households willing to undertake unskilled manual work.
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
department: Department of Rural Development
benefits: Provides wage employment opportunities and supports creation of rural public assets.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, household details, bank or postal account details and job card-related information.
application_process: Rural households can approach their Gram Panchayat to register and obtain a job card and request employment.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: A scheme aimed at providing clean cooking fuel in the form of LPG connections to eligible women from deprived households.
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefits: LPG connection assistance for eligible households along with applicable support under the scheme.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, address proof, household details, bank account details and eligibility-related documents.
application_process: Eligible applicants can apply through participating LPG distributors or the designated online application process.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
description: A maternity benefit scheme providing financial assistance to eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers subject to scheme conditions.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Department of Women and Child Development
benefits: Financial assistance to eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers under prescribed maternity benefit conditions.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, bank account details, pregnancy-related records and other documents prescribed under the scheme.
application_process: Eligible beneficiaries can apply through designated Anganwadi Centres or approved implementing authorities.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: A financing scheme supporting micro and small non-corporate and non-farm enterprises by facilitating access to institutional credit.
ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Financial Services
benefits: Institutional credit support for eligible micro and small enterprises and entrepreneurs.
documents_required: Identity proof, address proof, business documents, bank account details and other documents required by the lending institution.
application_process: Eligible entrepreneurs can approach participating banks, NBFCs or MFIs and submit a loan application under the applicable MUDRA category.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: An affordable accident insurance scheme providing insurance coverage against accidental death and disability to eligible subscribers.
ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Financial Services
benefits: Accident insurance coverage for eligible subscribers against accidental death and specified disabilities.
documents_required: Bank account details, Aadhaar or other accepted identification and consent for premium auto-debit.
application_process: Eligible individuals can enroll through participating banks or financial institutions by providing the required consent and documents.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: A government-backed life insurance scheme providing life insurance coverage to eligible subscribers.
ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Financial Services
benefits: Life insurance coverage for eligible subscribers under the terms of the scheme.
documents_required: Bank account details, Aadhaar or accepted identification and consent for premium auto-debit.
application_process: Eligible individuals can enroll through participating banks or financial institutions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: A micro-credit scheme designed to provide working capital loans to street vendors to help them resume and strengthen their businesses.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Collateral-free working capital support for eligible street vendors along with applicable incentives for digital transactions and timely repayment.
documents_required: Street vendor identification or certificate, Aadhaar Card, bank account details and other documents required for verification.
application_process: Eligible street vendors can apply through the PM SVANidhi portal, participating financial institutions or designated local authorities.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
description: A flagship scheme for the sustainable development of India's fisheries sector and improvement of fish production, productivity and livelihoods.
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
department: Department of Fisheries
benefits: Support for fisheries infrastructure, production, productivity, value chains and livelihoods under eligible components.
documents_required: Identity proof, bank account details, project or beneficiary documents and other documents prescribed for the applicable component.
application_process: Eligible beneficiaries and entities apply through the designated fisheries department and implementing authorities under applicable scheme components.

name: Pradhan Mantri Vishwakarma
description: A central sector scheme supporting traditional artisans and craftspeople through recognition, skill training, toolkit assistance, credit support and market linkages.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: Certificate and identity card, skill training, toolkit incentive, credit support, digital transaction incentives and marketing support for eligible artisans.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, mobile number, bank account details and documents required for verification of eligibility and traditional occupation.
application_process: Eligible artisans can register through Common Service Centres and complete the prescribed verification process.

name: One Nation One Ration Card
description: A national portability initiative enabling eligible ration card beneficiaries to access their entitled foodgrains through the public distribution system across participating states and union territories.
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
department: Department of Food and Public Distribution
benefits: Portability of foodgrain entitlements for eligible beneficiaries across participating states and union territories.
documents_required: Ration Card, Aadhaar or other identification documents and biometric authentication as applicable.
application_process: Eligible beneficiaries use their existing ration card and authentication at participating Fair Price Shops.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
description: A government scheme promoting rooftop solar installation for residential electricity consumers and providing financial assistance for eligible installations.
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefits: Central financial assistance for eligible residential rooftop solar installations and support for household electricity savings.
documents_required: Electricity consumer details, identity proof, bank account details and documents required for rooftop solar installation and subsidy processing.
application_process: Residential consumers can apply through the National Portal for Rooftop Solar, select a registered vendor and complete installation and verification procedures.
